beats.beat: The company processes and sells four product categories: Functional Additives (FA), Chemically Modified Minerals (CMM), Soft Minerals (SM) and Hard Minerals (HM).
Sales are largely channelled through the corporate promoter's network under a long-term arrangement, creating a close dependency.
Its top 10 customers contributed around 59% of revenue from operations in each of the last three financial years (FY2015–17), indicating customer concentration.
During the past five years, exports to Nigeria, Saudi Arabia and Sri Lanka totalled Rs 1,068.18 lakh.

The company lists as key strengths a diversified product portfolio, diversified user industries, import substitution, support from its holding company, product innovation and a strong management team.

Basic earnings per share (Rs) followed the same trend: FY2013: (0.45), FY2014: (0.20), FY2015: 2.47, FY2016: 1.46, FY2017: 2.43, six months Sep 2017: 1.48.
Net cash from operations was negative in FY2014 (Rs -349.75 lakh) but positive in all other periods; the six-month period ended Sep 2017 showed an inflow of Rs 200.97 lakh.
Total assets stood at Rs 3,018.66 lakh as of Sep 30, 2017, up from Rs 2,679.38 lakh in FY2013.
Contingent liabilities not provided for aggregated Rs 29.11 lakh as of Sep 30, 2017.

beats.beat: The promoters of the company are 20 Microns Limited (corporate promoter), Mr. Chandresh S. Parikh, Mr. Atil C. Parikh, and Mr. Rajesh C. Parikh.
Collectively, the promoters hold 89,48,270 equity shares, representing 99.76% of the pre-issue paid-up equity share capital.
The promoter group (excluding the promoters) holds an additional 21,510 shares, or 0.24%.
The company has entered into related-party transactions in each of the last five financial years and in the six-month period ended Sep 30, 2017, as detailed in the financial statements.
Authorised share capital is Rs 2,000 lakh, while issued, subscribed and paid-up capital is Rs 897 lakh (89,70,000 equity shares of Rs 10 each).

beats.beat: The Indian chemicals industry (excluding pharma and fertilisers) is estimated at Rs 5,800–6,200 billion in FY2017; the specialty chemicals segment alone accounts for about Rs 1,000 billion (~17% share).
Specialty chemicals grew at 10–12% CAGR from FY2014 to FY2017 and is forecast to grow at 12–14% CAGR, according to CRISIL Research.
The industry is highly fragmented, with small and medium enterprises (SMEs) holding a 70–75% market share.

Government initiatives include a Draft National Chemical Policy, 100% FDI approval in the sector, and four Petroleum, Chemicals and Petrochemicals Investment Regions (PCPIRs) with proposed investments of about Rs 9 trillion.
Key regulations include GST (effective July 2017) and REACH compliance for exports to Europe.
Demand drivers cited include rising urbanisation (31% urban population in 2011, expected 36% by 2020), growing middle-class, and increased consumption intensity.

beats.beat: 20 Microns Nano Minerals processes and sells specialty chemicals including Functional Additives, Chemically Modified Minerals, and soft and hard minerals.
It has a long-term arrangement with its corporate promoter, 20 Microns Limited, to market and sell its products through the promoter's network.
The IPO is a fresh issue (no offer for sale) with proceeds earmarked for capital expenditure on a new manufacturing facility in GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, and for general corporate purposes.
The company will list on the SME platform of NSE (NSE EMERGE).
Promoters hold 99.76% of the pre-issue paid-up equity, meaning almost no public float exists today.

intro.purpose: Orient the reader: describe the company, its offer type, and the key fact of promoter concentration.

beats.beat: The issue is a fresh issue of equity shares; the DRHP does not disclose the exact number of shares or the price band.
Proceeds from the fresh issue will fund capital expenditure for a new manufacturing facility at Plot 336, GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat.
General corporate purposes is another stated object.
A further objective is to create a public trading market for the company’s shares by listing on the SME Platform of NSE (NSE EMERGE), enhancing visibility and brand.
The lead manager to the issue is Vivro Financial Services Private Limited, and the registrar is Link Intime India Private Limited.

offer.heading: The offer and its objects
offer.purpose: Describe the offer structure (fresh issue), use of proceeds, and listing venue.

beats.beat: The company has no long-term or definitive agreements with either customers or raw material suppliers; business relies on purchase orders, creating revenue and supply uncertainty.
Cash flows from operations were negative in FY2014, and any sustained negative cash flow could impact growth and operations.
Key manufacturing facilities and administrative offices are on leased premises; the company does not own these properties.
Certain statutory licences for the manufacturing facility at Plot 9–10, GIDC Waghodia have not yet been obtained, exposing the company to potential penalties.
There have been past instances of non-filing or delays in statutory filings with the Registrar of Companies.
Related-party transactions exist and may continue; unsecured loans taken by the company or promoters are recallable at any time.
Exposure to foreign exchange rate fluctuations may harm results and cash flows.
The company, its promoters, group companies and directors are parties to certain legal proceedings; an adverse outcome could materially affect business.
